children: Canada building materials retailer's Q3 revenue rose 13% yr/yr, driven by acquisitions
Gross profit grew 15% yr/yr, with gross margin improving to 39.7%
Company signed agreement to acquire U.S. Midwest carpet and flooring business after quarter-end
Company says near-term demand remains subdued due to local economic conditions and high interest rates
BuildDirect plans to expand Pro Center network and pursue targeted acquisitions for growth
Company aims to integrate recent acquisitions and improve operational efficiency
ACQUISITIONS OFFSET DECLINES - Tile Outlets of America and Greyne contributed to revenue growth, more than offsetting lower sales in existing operations
SOFT DEMAND IN MICHIGAN - Softer local economic conditions and elevated interest rates weighed on construction activity and demand from production builders and multifamily customers in Michigan
WORKING CAPITAL IMPACT - Changes in non-cash working capital contributed $1.2 mln to positive operating cash flow in the quarter
The stock recently traded at 18 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 20 three months ago
